title: Kodaikanal
subtitle: Hill Station Escape · Bryant Park · Coakers Walk · Pillar Rocks
inclusions: Sleeper Train Tickets both ways (3AC upgrade available)

travel.departure: CSMT Mumbai — 8:00 PM, 26 Mar | Pune Jn. — 11:30 PM, 26 Mar
travel.arrival: Reach Pune by 02:00 AM, 01 Apr | Reach Mumbai by 06:00 AM, 01 Apr (Dadar Central Chalukya Exp 11022)

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: 26 March 2026 (Thursday) — Reporting Station: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT). Board the overnight train for Kodaikanal. Train departure: 8:00 PM. Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Train Journey
itinerary.description: 27 March 2026 (Friday) — Enjoy the scenic train journey. Watch the landscapes change as you travel south. Overnight on train.

itinerary.title: Reach Kodaikanal & Begin Sightseeing
itinerary.description: 28 March 2026 (Saturday) — Reach Kodaikanal Road station by 4:00 AM. Freshen up at the station. Transfer to hotel and check in (early check-in subject to availability). After breakfast, begin local sightseeing. Enroute lunch (at own cost).

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal Sightseeing
itinerary.description: 29 March 2026 (Sunday) — After breakfast, proceed for full-day Kodaikanal sightseeing. Visit Bryant Park, Coaker's Walk, Pillar Rocks, and other scenic points. Enroute lunch (at own cost). Return to hotel.

itinerary.title: More Sightseeing
itinerary.description: 30 March 2026 (Monday) — After breakfast, continue sightseeing. Visit Dolphin Nose, Pine Forest, and other attractions. Enroute lunch (at own cost). Return to hotel for dinner.

itinerary.title: Return Journey Begins
itinerary.description: 31 March 2026 (Tuesday) — After breakfast, check out from hotel. Begin return journey to Mumbai with memories of the trip with your travel buddies.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: 01 April 2026 (Wednesday) — Reach Mumbai by approximately 6:00 AM. Return home with sweet memories!
